title: Apprentice Sales Advisor
description:
What's in it for you:
- A great starting salary of £22,527 rising to £26,738 after completion of the apprenticeship. Plus, an uncapped commission scheme.
- An NVQ Level 2 in Customer Service following the completion of the apprenticeship (15 months)
- Huge discounts off your Mobile and Broadband packages, starting at £10 a month
- Huge discounts off other tech such as Smart watches, speakers, tv's, gaming consoles and subscriptions
- Discount codes to give out to friends and family
- Support to carve your own career path. We're passionate about helping our people grow the career they want
- Season Ticket Travel Loan - giving you the funds to pay for your travel to and from work up front
- Online GP: Access to a private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family

What you'll be doing

At EE, we believe every customer interaction should be a positive experience. You'll speak with customers over the phone, getting to know what matters most to them, building strong relationships, and recommending the right EE products and services to suit their needs. You'll use your energy and ambition to thrive and meet goals, and grow your skills along the way. From the latest mobile tech and broadband, and smart home solutions, every conversation is a chance to make a real impact and grow your confidence.

Why choose EE

You don't need experience, all you need is a great attitude, a friendly voice, and the willingness to learn. We'll give you all the training you need and we're passionate about helping you kick start your career.

At EE, you're part of something bigger. You'll make friends, learn new skills, and build confidence every day. We're proud to be inclusive and welcome people from all backgrounds - because everyone belongs here.

Ready to make your mark? Apply now and let's start building your future.

title: BMW Sales Executive
description:
BMW SALES EXECUTIVE.

Earn up to £60,000 OTE per annum plus a Company Car!

WHY WORK FOR HEDIN AUTOMOTIVE BMW & MINI.

Join the Hedin Automotive sales team as a BMW Sales Executive and help customers find their perfect BMW while delivering an exceptional buying experience. You'll represent one of the world's leading premium automotive brands, guiding customers through every stage of their journey, from their initial enquiry through to vehicle handover. With access to the latest BMW models, innovative technology, and ongoing manufacturer training, you'll have everything you need to build a rewarding career in automotive sales.

BENEFITS.

Hedin Automotive values our employees and invests in personal development and training. In addition, we offer a wide range of market-leading benefits to all our colleagues.
- 31 days of annual leave (including bank holidays) with long-service awards and enhanced holiday entitlement
- Discount schemes with popular retailers - helping you save more
- Employee Car Ownership Schemes - available for you and your family
- Employee Assistance Programme - 24/7 wellbeing support with access to health professionals
- Private healthcare access - prioritising your health and prosperity
- Pension scheme and life assurance - confidence in your future
- Referral bonus - earn when you refer a friend to join the team

Why not take a moment to view all our benefits and see what our employees love about working at Hedin Automotive by visiting our

THE MAIN DUTIES OF THE ROLE INCLUDE:
- Guiding customers through the complete sales journey, from initial enquiry and test drive through to finance, accessories, and vehicle handover
- Providing expert advice across the full range of new and approved used BMW models
- Identifying customer needs and delivering tailored solutions while achieving individual sales targets
- Proactively building relationships with new and existing customers to generate repeat business and referrals
- Assisting customers with vehicle configuration, finance options, and part-exchange valuations
- Negotiating sales professionally while ensuring an outstanding customer experience
- Accurately processing sales contracts, vehicle orders, and finance documentation
- Acting as a brand ambassador for BMW and maintaining exceptional product knowledge

YOUR PROFILE.
- Strong communication, influencing, and negotiation skills to close sales
- Highly motivated with a passion for achieving and exceeding sales targets
- Enjoy following processes, handling administration, and working under pressure
- Well-organised with excellent diary management and timely follow-ups
- Skilled at building rapport, earning trust, and resolving conflicts calmly.
- Enthusiastic about customer service, professional, and well-presented
- Proven Sales experience in the automotive industry preferred.

SALARY AND WORKING HOURS.
- Basic salary of £23,000 per annum with a competitive OTE of £50,000-£60,000, with a Company Car
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 6pm with a day off during the week, plus every Saturday, 8:30am to 5pm (41.5 hours per week). Additionally, will be required to work Sundays on a rota basis (1 in 15).

ABOUT US.

Hedin Automotive is a well-established BMW & MINI franchise with state-of-the-art centres across North London, East London, and Kent.

As part of Hedin Mobility Group-one of the world's leading private automotive retail and aftermarket services providers we are dedicated to excellence in everything we do. Whether in customer-facing roles or the workshop, our incredible teams are passionate about making Hedin Automotive a seamless, enjoyable place to do business. We strive to create great experiences through a team that genuinely cares about our customers.

Click apply today and take the first step towards a rewarding career in the automotive industry.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive - Construction Property Professional Indemnity

Overview:

As a Business Development Executive, you will proactively engage with mid-market and SME businesses across the UK, with a particular focus on clients within the construction and property professional services sector. This includes organisations such as surveyors, architects, design and planning consultancies, and engineering firms across all disciplines. You will help clients understand how you / our client can support their insurance needs, gaining valuable experience in identifying risk exposures, discussing tailored insurance solutions, and promoting end-to-end service-from initial consultation through to long-term partnership.

Your role will be central to expanding our clients client base and supporting our mission to deliver exceptional, specialist-led insurance solutions. Whether you are advising a local professional practice or supporting the placement of more complex programmes for growing and internationally active firms, your contribution will play a key role in driving continued growth.

Responsibilities:

Proactively contact prospective clients to introduce, gather relevant insurance information, and support negotiations with both clients and insurers.

Identify, research, and develop new sources of prospective clients to help expand presence and market reach.

Work closely with brokers and account handlers to support the onboarding and development of potential new clients.

Accurately maintain client and prospect records on our CRM systems, ensuring all information is recorded promptly and kept up to date in line with company standards.

Build a strong foundation of Professional Indemnity Insurance knowledge, including working towards and achieving CII insurance qualifications.

Actively participate in structured training and development programmes focused on building the core skills required for success in the role.

Contribute as part of a fast-paced, collaborative, and continually evolving environment, with significant opportunities for learning and professional growth.

Requirements:

Previous experience within the insurance market and sales.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Our clients team thrives on effective communication and the ability to work together towards common goals.

Sales and negotiation skills that will help you compete in a fast-paced market.

Strong motivation and ambition in progressing your career in insurance.

An eye for detail to ensure that all records and client interactions are meticulously managed and maintained.

title: Business Development Executive
description:

title: Business Development Executive 12-month FTC
company: Norton Rose Fulbright LLP - Agency - Permanent
description:
Practice Group / Department:

Business Development - ESG - London

Job Description

Norton Rose Fulbright is a global law firm with more than 3,000 lawyers advising clients across locations in the United States, Europe, Canada, Latin America, Asia, Australia, Africa and the Middle East. We provide a full scope of legal services to the world's preeminent corporations and financial institutions.

Our vision is to be a world class business, profitable, ambitious, cooperative and considerate, supporting our clients and people through our global business principles of Quality, Unity and Integrity.

With over 7,000 employees worldwide, our culture is the thread that connects us. Our strategy and culture are closed connected - defined by shared ambition, global collaboration and a one-team mindset. We believe pioneering work happens when people are empowered to think beyond boundaries, explore new opportunities and grow through diverse experiences. Alongside the right skills and experience, we are looking for people who are innovative, commercially minded, and motivated by the impact of the work they do - ready to share in our ambition and help shape what comes next.

Because while individuals can do well, together we achieve something extraordinary.

The Role

The Business Development Executive (BDE) role is a permanent role within NRF's London office in the Marketing & Business Development (MBD) function and the Europe, Middle East & Asia (EMEA) region at Norton Rose Fulbright.

The role reports to a Senior Business Development Manager responsible for strategic growth initiatives across sectors and practice areas, and will work closely with the Business Development Manager supporting the Real Estate, Tax and Employment practices.

This position offers the opportunity to develop specialist knowledge within these practice areas while also contributing to initiatives and campaigns that span multiple sectors, practices and regions. The role holder will work with a diverse range of colleagues across the firm, building a strong internal network and gaining valuable insight into how collaboration drives client relationships and business growth.

Working closely with business development managers and partners, the role holder will contribute to the delivery of the team's business development strategy. This includes supporting client development initiatives, marketing campaigns, events and profile-raising activities, while building effective relationships with stakeholders across the firm.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone developing their career in business development. The role provides exposure to a wide range of strategic and client-facing activities, regular interaction with partners and senior colleagues, and the opportunity to develop commercial awareness, relationship management and project management expertise.

The role holder will also work in close co-operation with colleagues across the global and EMEA Marketing and Business Development teams as well as our support team in Newcastle.

Key Responsibilities
- Producing bespoke bids, credentials, pitches, presentations and other client development and marketing content (formal and informal).
- Working with the relevant practice leadership and BD managers to create and implement business plans, budget proposals and campaign plans for the EMEA region.
- Assisting with all aspects of the planning, development and implementation of BD and marketing activity. This includes, but is not limited to, business development, client development, profile raising, marketing, communications, bids and event management.
- Acting as a key point of contact and ambassador for the practice.
- Establishing a close and effective relationship with the lawyers and partners within the practices.
- Working closely with other MBD teams, including the client relationship team, strategic bids, events, design and digital, and our Newcastle-based marketing services team.
- Coordinating and drafting directory and award submissions.
- Ensure marketing materials are kept up to date.
- Supporting the management of relevant MBD budgets, including reporting of ROI.
- Contributing and leading on best practice.

Key Skills and Experience
- Graduate calibre with demonstrable and/or professionally recognised BD, marketing or communications qualification (such as CIM, etc).
- Experience in marketing and business development is desirable, as is experience of working in a legal/professional services/partnership environment.
- Excellent written and oral communication skills, including strong attention to detail.
- Confident and willing to take on additional responsibility as required.
- Highly organised with a professional, confident, collaborative and proactive approach to their role.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, multiple tasks and stakeholders.
- Experience in managing and writing bids or similar sales writing is desirable.
- Understands the need, and has the ability, to manage expectations.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

To attract the best people, we strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone can bring their whole selves to work, have a sense of belonging, and realize their full career potential.
Our new enabled work model allows our people to have more flexibility in the way they choose to work from both the office and a remote location, while continuing to deliver the highest standards of service. We offer a range of family friendly and inclusive employment policies and provide access to programmes and services aimed at nurturing our people's health and overall wellbeing. Find more about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion here.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from individuals who can complement our existing teams. We strive to create an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any tailored adjustments or accommodations, please let us know here.

description:

Salary: £30,973.00 + 30% OTE

We're looking for ambitious, target-driven sales professionals to join our SME Customer Success teams, helping small businesses across the UK grow with BT and EE.

If you thrive in a fast-paced contact centre environment, enjoy hitting targets, and want to develop a long-term sales career, this is your opportunity to step into a role with real earning potential, variety, and progression.

What you'll be doing

You'll be at the heart of SME growth, using strong sales skills and customer conversations to win and grow business by converting inbound and outbound leads, while upselling and cross-selling across mobile, connectivity and digital services.

You'll manage a portfolio of SME customers, build relationships with business owners and decision-makers, and use outbound activity to identify needs and match the right solutions, while keeping CRM systems accurate and following best practice.

Acquisition

This role is primarily focused on new business sales, targeting smaller SME Business customers (0-49 employees) with a strong emphasis on outbound cold calling activity and pipeline generation.

Customer Success

This role is more relationship-led, with a broader focus on ongoing account management. This includes retention, upsell, and growth of existing customers, alongside some new business activity (10-50 employees).

What you'll need to succeed

Essential
- Experience in a sales environment
- Strong communication skills with the ability to sell, influence and build trust
- Confidence using CRM systems and digital tools
- A positive, coachable mindset with a willingness to learn

Desirable
- Proven track record of hitting or exceeding sales targets
- Experience in telesales or outbound sales environments

What's in it for you?

Tailored benefits make a real difference. That's why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing and everyday life. You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include:
- 30% OTE Bonus
- Monday-Friday shift pattern
